ja.title: エラナタマブの初回用量とCRSを公開モデルで比較する
ja.summary: BCMA×CD3二重特異性抗体エラナタマブの公開PopPKモデル（sBCMA結合の準平衡モデル）とCRSの曝露反応モデルを使い、最初のステップアップ用量の設計を仮想患者4,096人で比べる。腫瘍量に応じて最初の用量を変える設計を、前向きに比べる候補として示す。
ja.seo_title: エラナタマブの初回用量とCRSを比較する
ja.seo_description: エラナタマブの公開PopPKとCRS曝露反応モデルから、初回ステップアップ用量を仮想比較。腫瘍量による設計とモデル外挿の限界を検討する。

en.title: How to take the first step: comparing elranatamab step-up designs and CRS with public models
en.summary: Published elranatamab PK and first-dose CRS models compare step-up hypotheses while separating recalibration, later-dose risk, and untested clinical benefit.
en.seo_title: Elranatamab step-up dosing and first-dose CRS
en.seo_description: Published elranatamab PK and first-dose CRS models compare step-up hypotheses while separating recalibration, later-dose risk, and untested clinical benefit.

english.title: How to take the first step: comparing elranatamab step-up designs and CRS with public models
english.summary: A Japanese technical note that combines the published quasi-equilibrium PopPK model and the CRS exposure-response model of elranatamab to compare first step-up doses in 4,096 virtual patients, proposing tumour-burden-adapted priming as a candidate for prospective comparison.
